# illustration.app

> > AI-powered illustration generator creating customizable SVG and PNG artwork for design projects, with curated packs and free design tools.

illustration.app is an AI illustration platform that enables designers and non-designers to generate scalable vector artwork across diverse themes including automation, productivity, finance, wellness, and cultural heritage. The platform offers pre-made illustration packs with consistent styling, an integrated design tools directory, and comprehensive resources for modern design workflows.

## Key Topics

- AI Illustration Generator

## Core Generator & Packs

- [illustration.app - AI Illustration Generator](https://www.illustration.app): AI illustration generator creating scalable SVG/PNG artwork for design projects
- [Illustration Packs](https://www.illustration.app/packs): Browse curated illustration packs with consistent styles and themed collections
- [AI Automation Concepts - Illustration Pack](https://www.illustration.app/pack/ai-automation-concepts): 25 vibrant flat-style illustrations depicting AI automation concepts for tech
- [Goal Setter Toolkit - Illustration Pack](https://www.illustration.app/pack/goal-setter-toolkit): 25 flat character illustrations for productivity, goal-setting, and new year themes
- [Financial Planning and Tax Management - Illustration Pack](https://www.illustration.app/pack/financial-planning-and-tax-management): 25 soft-shade illustrations for financial planning, tax, and wealth management
